messages:
Maya Patel: Quick ask — partnerships needs a tiny canonical example of vendor supply inputs for the cost model. vendors gave CSVs with different columns. can someone paste a minimal, normalized example we can use as the ingestion spec?

Jon Kim: +1. finance needs reserved vs spot blended rate and the credit lag so we can amortize commit credits across months.

Priya Rao: Minimal fields we actually use: SKU, region, gpu_type, reserved_hour_usd, spot_hour_usd, reserved_commit_min_hours, reserve_tenor_months, eviction_rate_pct, credit_lag_days, burst_eligible(boolean).

Evan Li: this is important for routing too — need preemptibility windows/state so smart routing can prefer non-evictible capacity for latency SLOs. maybe add "eviction_window_hours" and "preemptibility_type" (e.g., preemptible, reclaimable, none).

Kelsey (CoreWeave): FYI CoreWeave can provide both spot + reserved pricing per region. sample rows below from our side (sanitized):

```
SKU,region,gpu_type,reserved_hour_usd,spot_hour_usd,reserved_commit_min_hours,reserve_tenor_months,eviction_rate_pct,credit_lag_days,burst_eligible,eviction_window_hours,preemptibility_type
cw-a100-80-usw,us-west,A100-80,3.20,0.85,720,12,2.5,14,true,6,preemptible
cw-rtx6000-use,us-east,RTX6000,1.80,0.50,360,6,4.0,7,false,24,reclaimable
```

Maya Patel: perfect — can we include a column for "min_reserve_granularity_hours" (some partners only sell monthly blocks) and "billing_credit_type" (one-time rebate vs monthly credit)?

Priya Rao: yes please. also include sample metadata for SKU lifecycle: available_from, deprecation_date (nullable). we need that to model migration windows.

Jon Kim: question on credit_lag_days — is that vendor-reported delay before credits appear on invoice? if so, we need to model cashflow timing (very important for reserved commits).

Kelsey (CoreWeave): correct, credit_lag_days = days after invoice when the committed discount shows up as a contra-charge. we normally report 14-30 days depending on contract. monthly billing credits are common for 12m tenors.

Evan Li: another practical thing — provide a small example of how preemptibility affects effective price at 99th pct latency. i.e., a piecewise rule: if eviction_rate_pct > 3% then apply a 10% latency penalty uplift or route to non-preemptible SKU.

Priya Rao: noted. for the ingestion spec I'll produce a sample header w/ descriptions and a one-row example (including credit type). putting draft here so partners can map columns:

```
# Column,description,example
SKU,unique partner sku for mapping,cw-a100-80-usw
region,aws-like region code,us-west
gpu_type,short gpu family,A100-80
reserved_hour_usd,hourly price when reserved,3.20
spot_hour_usd,hourly price when ephemeral,0.85
reserved_commit_min_hours,min hours to qualify for reserved price,720
reserve_tenor_months,commit tenor in months,12
min_reserve_granularity_hours,min sell block hours (0 if hourly),720
eviction_rate_pct,estimated fraction of spot preemptions per month,2.5
eviction_window_hours,typical contiguous eviction window in hours,6
preemptibility_type,none|preemptible|reclaimable,preemptible
billing_credit_type,monthly|one-time,monthly
credit_lag_days,days until credit applied,14
burst_eligible,boolean if can burst beyond reserved pool,true
available_from,ISO date when SKU available,2025-01-01
deprecation_date,ISO date when SKU retired or empty,
```

Maya Patel: this is great. action items: Priya will send spec to partners + example CSV mapping; Kelsey will confirm whether CoreWeave provides eviction_rate_pct per day or per month; Jon will add a cashflow line to the cost model template to accept credit_lag_days.

Jon Kim: i'll slot this into next week's finance sync. can someone cc the marketplace onboarding PM so they can require this in the listing CSV? @Evan Li can you ping @marketplace-pm?

Evan Li: pinged them in #product-onboarding. also created a small ticket to accept both monthly and one-time credit types in the ingestion pipeline.

Kelsey (CoreWeave): will send a full sample CSV tomorrow with regional breakdown and any minimums. thanks all :thumbsup:

supply-bot: Reminder — please attach the final CSV to the partnerships/vendor-supply folder in Drive within 48h.
